BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

5. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

7. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

8. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.

9. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.

10. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

11. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

12. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.

15. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
